on-the-job-training.title: On-the-Job Training (OJT)
on-the-job-training.content:
COURSES & TRAINING

On-the-Job Training (OJT)

Practical workplace-embedded capability interventions combining structured coaching, live task execution, and milestone-based ROI.

PRACTICAL WORKPLACE INTEGRATION

Embedding Competencies Directly in Daily Workflows

While classroom sessions introduce essential concepts, sustainable skill mastery occurs through active workplace application. GET Academy’s On-the-Job Training (OJT) methodology embeds structured learning directly within actual daily operations, minimizing operational downtime while accelerating capability development.

Through structured coaching milestones and guided supervisor mentorship, participants apply acquired techniques directly to organizational workflows, driving verifiable improvements in team productivity and output quality.

Why Organisations Choose OJT

  • Zero Downtime Disruption: Learning occurs parallel to ongoing organizational deliverables.
  • Immediate Workplace Transfer: Concepts are tested, refined, and adopted on real-world projects immediately.
  • Supervisor & Mentor Alignment: Involves internal leaders to ensure long-term behavioral change.
  • Milestone-Based Tracking: Verifiable progress rubrics that measure individual and team ROI.

Workplace-Embedded Learning

Bridging conceptual frameworks with day-to-day execution to deliver lasting business productivity.

THE METHODOLOGY

The GET Academy OJT Framework

A structured 3-phase delivery process tailored to your operational ecosystem.

01

Diagnostic & Task Mapping

Assessing departmental workflows to map concrete tasks where skill gaps impede operational momentum.

02

Milestone Execution

Guiding learners through live workplace assignments with expert feedback checkpoints and peer collaboration.

03

Performance Verification

Evaluating workplace capability improvements against defined productivity rubrics and departmental KPIs.
